text: dshdesk（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：把会话状态整理成只读注意力看板。它在侧边栏提供看板入口，并按需要你、进行中、验收和完成分栏展示会话；桌面环境还可打开 Windows 置顶小窗。适合需要快速查看哪些会话待处理或待验收的 DSH 用户。无需 API 密钥或外部服务；置顶窗需 Windows PowerShell。

dshdesk (DSH Web plugin) shows sessions in a read-only sidebar board grouped as Needs you, In progress, Review, and Done. Compatible Windows desktops can open an always-on-top companion window. No API key or external service is needed; the optional window requires Windows PowerShell.
想快速看出哪些 DSH 会话正等我处理。
能不能把运行中、待验收和已完成的会话分开显示？
I want a read-only overview of sessions that need my attention.
dshdesk 的功能「会话注意力分栏」：在侧栏看板中将会话按需要你、进行中、验收和完成分组，状态由 DSH 会话信息推导，供用户只读查看。
dshdesk 的功能「Windows 置顶小窗」：在宿主具备 PowerShell 的桌面环境中可打开原生置顶看板，查看主窗口同步的会话快照。

dshdesk README · dshdesk：> 一条注意力队列。只回答一个问题：**现在有没有事需要我？**

`dshdesk` 是 DeepSeek Harness 的只读任务看板。它把会话列表折成四栏——**需要你 / 进行中 / 验收 / 完成**——栏位完全由 DSH 自己的会话状态推导，不需要手动维护，也不会写回任何状态。侧边栏底部有一个总览按钮；点开是 860px 宽的实时气泡；在桌面端还可以钉成一个真正的 Windows 系统置顶小窗。

dshdesk README · 四栏怎么来：| 栏位 | 依据 | 与 DSH 一致的状态点 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 需要你 | `pendingInteraction`（审批 / 计划待审 / 待回答） | 琥珀 |
| 进行中 | `running`，且没有待处理交互 | DSH ongoing 环 |
| 验收 | `completionUnread`（会话在你没看时完成） | 绿 |
| 完成 | 以上都不是 | 中性 |

- 空白会话、子代理会话、已归档会话不显示。
- 当前会话排在所属栏第一位，并带「当前」标记。
- 待处理交互优先于进行中，和 DSH 侧边栏的优先级一致。
- 卡片只读：不能拖到别的栏、不能手动完成、不会写入会话状态。

dshdesk README · 侧边栏气泡（所有环境）：- 侧边栏底部按钮显示**活跃队列总数**（需要你 + 进行中 + 验收，不含完成），以及琥珀 / 绿色状态点；宽栏和 56px 窄栏都能用。总数为 0 就表示现在没有事需要你。
- 点开是 860px 气泡，贴在按钮右侧，四栏等宽；空栏写「暂无」。
- 点击任意卡片会跳到对应会话并收起气泡；置顶小窗里的卡片同样可点。
- 气泡可拖动，`Esc` 或点击外部关闭。
- 只在看板未聚焦时，新进入「需要你」或「验收」的会话才发系统通知。

dshdesk README · 置顶小窗（仅桌面端 + Windows）：网页不会假装浏览器标签能置顶，因此按钮是否出现由两层判断共同决定：

1. 页面确实在 DSH 桌面壳里（`dshDesktop`、`data-windows-titlebar`、`dsh-app:` 等标记）；
2. 宿主能启动 Windows 原生窗口（Windows，或 WSL 里有 `powershell.exe`）。

满足时点图钉会打开一个 PowerShell 5.1 + WPF 的真窗口：

- 900 × 620，无边框，`Topmost`，最小 760 × 210；
- 默认 90% 透明度，头部滑块 30%–100% 可调，并记住上次的值；
- 800ms 拉取主窗快照；6 秒没有新快照就显示断线提示并关闭；
- 关闭后自动回到气泡；
- 浅 / 深色跟随宿主 `--dsw-*` token，不另造一套配色；
- 只读，没有任何会改会话状态的控件。

小窗由一个仅监听 `127.0.0.1`、带随机 token 的镜像服务供数；不经过公网，也没有额外的第三方请求。主题颜色使用 `#AARRGGBB`（WPF 顺序）传递，因此透明度边框不会在原生窗口里变色。
section: 置顶小窗（仅桌面端 + Windows）

text:
dshdesk README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Pingze-github/dshdesk

dshdesk README · 或本地开发：dsh plugin --profile web add link:/mnt/f/DSH/dshdesk
```

安装后刷新页面。插件没有构建脚本、没有 `postinstall`，`client.js` 已是最终产物。

dshdesk README · 已知边界：- 置顶窗只支持 Windows + PowerShell 5.1 + WPF。macOS / Linux / 纯浏览器不会显示图钉。
- 小窗的实时性依赖主页面继续运行；主页面关闭或休眠超过 6 秒，小窗按设计关闭。
- 原生窗口日志在 `%TEMP%\dshdesk-window.log`。
- 浏览器通知需要在点击看板时授权；已被系统 / 浏览器禁用时不会弹。
- 看板不持久化卡片状态，因为它不拥有状态。

dshdesk README · 开发：```bash
bash scripts/check.sh        # 唯一成功标准
bash scripts/smoke.sh        # 热挂载 + 路由冒烟
node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

结构：

- `index.js` — 宿主：路由、快照存储、镜像服务、WPF 启动器。
- `lib/board.cjs` — 纯四栏推导 + 快照清洗；Node 测试与浏览器共用。
- `src/client.template.js` — 浏览器源码；生成 `client.js`。
- `native/dshdesk-window.ps1` — WPF 置顶窗。
- `scripts/build-client.mjs` — 把 `lib/board.cjs` 内联进单文件 bundle。

dshdesk README · dshdesk：> One attention queue. One question: **is anything waiting for me right now?**

`dshdesk` is a read-only task board for DeepSeek Harness. It folds the session list into four columns — **Needs you / In progress / Review / Done** — derived entirely from DSH's own session state. Nothing is authored, dragged, or marked done by hand. A footer button opens an 860px live bubble; on the Windows desktop shell the same board can be pinned into a true always-on-top system window.

dshdesk README · Columns：| Column | Source | Dot |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Needs you | `pendingInteraction` (approval / plan review / question) | amber |
| In progress | `running`, with no pending interaction | DSH ongoing ring |
| Review | `completionUnread` (finished while you were elsewhere) | green |
| Done | none of the above | neutral |

dshdesk README · Columns：Blank, subagent and archived sessions are hidden. The current session sits first in its own column and carries a `Current` badge. Pending interactions outrank running, matching DSH's sidebar precedence. Cards are display-only.

dshdesk README · Sidebar bubble (everywhere)：The footer button carries the active-queue total (needs you + in progress + review, excluding done) plus the amber and green dots, in both the wide sidebar and the 56px rail. It opens an 860px bubble to the right of the button, with four equal columns and `Nothing here` for empty ones. Clicking a card opens that session and closes the bubble; cards in the pinned window work the same way. The bubble can be dragged and closes on `Escape` or an outside press. Only **newly entering** Needs-you or Review items notify, and only while the board is unfocused.

dshdesk README · Pinned window (desktop + Windows only)：A browser tab cannot be always-on-top, so the pin is shown only when both are true:

1. the page runs inside a DSH desktop shell (`dshDesktop`, `data-windows-titlebar`, `dsh-app:`, etc.); and
2. the host can launch a native Windows window (Windows, or WSL with `powershell.exe`).

The pin opens a PowerShell 5.1 + WPF window:

dshdesk README · Pinned window (desktop + Windows only)：The companion is fed by a loopback-only, random-token mirror server. It makes no third-party requests. Theme colours travel as `#AARRGGBB` (WPF order) so translucent borders cannot turn into an unexpected hue in the native window.

dshdesk README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Pingze-github/dshdesk

dshdesk README · local development：dsh plugin --profile web add link:/mnt/f/DSH/dshdesk
```

Refresh the page after installing. No build step and no `postinstall`: `client.js` is committed.

dshdesk README · Limits：- The pinned window is Windows + PowerShell 5.1 + WPF only. macOS, Linux and plain browsers do not show it.
- Its liveness depends on the main page; closing or sleeping the page for more than 6s closes the companion by design.
- Browser notifications require permission, requested from the board click. A system/browser block wins.
- The board stores no card state, because it owns none.
- The native log is `%TEMP%\dshdesk-window.log`.

dshdesk README · Development：```bash
bash scripts/check.sh        # the single success criterion
bash scripts/smoke.sh        # hot-swap + route smoke
node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

dshdesk README · Development：- `index.js` — host routes, snapshot store, mirror server, WPF launcher.
- `lib/board.cjs` — pure derivation and sanitisation shared by Node tests and the browser.
- `src/client.template.js` — browser source; generates `client.js`.
- `native/dshdesk-window.ps1` — the WPF companion.
- `scripts/build-client.mjs` — inlines `lib/board.cjs` into one bundle.

- 小窗的实时性依赖主页面继续运行；主页面关闭或休眠超过 6 秒，小窗按设计关闭。
- 原生窗口日志在 `%TEMP%\dshdesk-window.log`。
- 浏览器通知需要在点击看板时授权；已被系统 / 浏览器禁用时不会弹。
- 看板不持久化卡片状态，因为它不拥有状态。

dshdesk README · 开发：```bash
bash scripts/check.sh        # 唯一成功标准

node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

结构：

- `index.js` — 宿主：路由、快照存储、镜像服务、WPF 启动器。
- `lib/board.cjs` — 纯四栏推导 + 快照清洗；Node 测试与浏览器共用。
- `src/client.template.js` — 浏览器源码；生成 `client.js`。
- `native/dshdesk-window.ps1` — WPF 置顶窗。
- `scripts/build-client.mjs` — 把 `lib/board.cjs` 内联进单文件 bundle。

dshdesk README · dshdesk：> One attention queue. One question: **is anything waiting for me right now?**

`dshdesk` is a read-only task board for DeepSeek Harness. It folds the session list into four columns — **Needs you / In progress / Review / Done** — derived entirely from DSH's own session state. Nothing is authored, dragged, or marked done by hand. A footer button opens an 860px live bubble; on the Windows desktop shell the same board can be pinned into a true always-on-top system window.

dshdesk README · Columns：| Column | Source | Dot |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Needs you | `pendingInteraction` (approval / plan review / question) | amber |
| In progress | `running`, with no pending interaction | DSH ongoing ring |
| Review | `completionUnread` (finished while you were elsewhere) | green |
| Done | none of the above | neutral |

dshdesk README · Columns：Blank, subagent and archived sessions are hidden. The current session sits first in its own column and carries a `Current` badge. Pending interactions outrank running, matching DSH's sidebar precedence. Cards are display-only.

dshdesk README · Sidebar bubble (everywhere)：The footer button carries the active-queue total (needs you + in progress + review, excluding done) plus the amber and green dots, in both the wide sidebar and the 56px rail. It opens an 860px bubble to the right of the button, with four equal columns and `Nothing here` for empty ones. Clicking a card opens that session and closes the bubble; cards in the pinned window work the same way. The bubble can be dragged and closes on `Escape` or an outside press. Only **newly entering** Needs-you or Review items notify, and only while the board is unfocused.

dshdesk README · Pinned window (desktop + Windows only)：A browser tab cannot be always-on-top, so the pin is shown only when both are true:

1. the page runs inside a DSH desktop shell (`dshDesktop`, `data-windows-titlebar`, `dsh-app:`, etc.); and
2. the host can launch a native Windows window (Windows, or WSL with `powershell.exe`).

The pin opens a PowerShell 5.1 + WPF window:

dshdesk README · Pinned window (desktop + Windows only)：The companion is fed by a loopback-only, random-token mirror server. It makes no third-party requests. Theme colours travel as `#AARRGGBB` (WPF order) so translucent borders cannot turn into an unexpected hue in the native window.

dshdesk README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Pingze-github/dshdesk

dshdesk README · local development：dsh plugin --profile web add link:/mnt/f/DSH/dshdesk
```

Refresh the page after installing. No build step and no `postinstall`: `client.js` is committed.

dshdesk README · Limits：- The pinned window is Windows + PowerShell 5.1 + WPF only. macOS, Linux and plain browsers do not show it.
- Its liveness depends on the main page; closing or sleeping the page for more than 6s closes the companion by design.
- Browser notifications require permission, requested from the board click. A system/browser block wins.
- The board stores no card state, because it owns none.
- The native log is `%TEMP%\dshdesk-window.log`.

dshdesk README · Development：```bash
bash scripts/check.sh        # the single success criterion
bash scripts/smoke.sh        # hot-swap + route smoke
node scripts/build-client.mjs
```

dshdesk README · Development：- `index.js` — host routes, snapshot store, mirror server, WPF launcher.
- `lib/board.cjs` — pure derivation and sanitisation shared by Node tests and the browser.
- `src/client.template.js` — browser source; generates `client.js`.
- `native/dshdesk-window.ps1` — the WPF companion.
- `scripts/build-client.mjs` — inlines `lib/board.cjs` into one bundle.
